t: Is Your Iron Pill 325 mg or 65 mg? How to Read Iron on US and Korean Labels
h:
By Nutri Note · Updated November 28, 2026 · Numbers checked against the NIH Office of Dietary Supplements iron fact sheet and Korea's labeling rules

The bottle says "Ferrous Sulfate 325 mg." The Korean box you picked up in Seoul says "철 12mg." Your multivitamin says 18 mg. Are these the same thing, and which one is "a lot"?

Short answer: only one number matters for comparing, and that's elemental iron, the iron itself. A 325 mg ferrous sulfate tablet holds about 65 mg of it. Below is how to find that number on a US label and on a Korean box, and what it means next to the daily targets.

Quick answer

  • Compare elemental iron: the "Iron" line in Supplement Facts, not the salt name on the front.
  • 325 mg ferrous sulfate ≈ 65 mg iron: ferrous sulfate is about 20% iron by weight.
  • Korean boxes: the 철 line is already the iron amount, but the % uses 12 mg as 100%.
  • Upper limit for adults: 45 mg a day (NIH). Add up every product you take before comparing.

Why the front of the bottle shows a bigger number

Iron in supplements comes as a salt: iron bound to something else. The front label often shows the weight of the whole salt. The NIH Office of Dietary Supplements gives the iron share for the common forms:

Form on the labelIron by weightIn a 325 mg tablet
Ferrous fumarate33%≈ 107 mg
Ferrous sulfate20%≈ 65 mg
Ferrous gluconate12%≈ 39 mg

The last column is simple math on a 325 mg example, so it's for illustration. Good news: NIH notes that elemental iron is listed in the Supplement Facts panel, so you don't have to calculate it. Find the "Iron" row and read the mg there.

How a Korean box shows iron

On a Korean box, look for the nutrition/function panel (영양·기능정보). The iron line reads 철 followed by mg, and that's the iron amount itself. The catch is the percent next to it.

US labelKorean box
Word to findIron철
What "100%" means18 mg (Daily Value)12 mg (Korean daily reference)
12 mg of iron shows as67% DV100%
18 mg of iron shows as100% DV150%

So a Korean "100%" is a smaller amount than a US "100%." When you compare boxes from two countries, compare the mg, not the percent.

How much do you actually need?

GroupRDA (NIH)
Men 19+8 mg
Women 19–5018 mg
Women 51+8 mg
Pregnancy27 mg

These targets are for total intake, food included. Vitamin C in the same meal helps your body absorb the iron in plant foods, NIH notes. NIH notes that women's multivitamins typically carry 18 mg, while men's and seniors' formulas often have less or none. Iron-only supplements often deliver 65 mg, which is over the 45 mg upper limit. That's why iron-only products are usually something people take after talking with a doctor, often after a blood test.

Three checks before you add an iron product

  1. Add up every label. A multivitamin plus a separate iron tablet plus a Korean "women's" stick can stack up. Total the mg across all of them.
  2. Space it from calcium. NIH says experts recommend taking calcium and iron supplements at different times.
  3. Check your medications. Iron can reduce absorption of levothyroxine (labels advise keeping them 4 hours apart) and levodopa, and acid-reducing PPIs can lower iron absorption. If you take any of these, ask your pharmacist about timing.

Keep it away from kids

US iron supplements in tablet or capsule form carry a warning because accidental iron overdose is a leading cause of fatal poisoning in children under 6. Korean boxes in a suitcase or on a hotel nightstand deserve the same care.

Bottom line

Read the Iron (철) line in mg, ignore the salt weight on the front, and remember that a Korean 100% means 12 mg, not 18 mg. Add up every product you take and keep NIH's 45 mg adult upper limit in mind unless your doctor has told you otherwise.

Who can skip this

If you're a man or a woman past menopause eating a regular diet, the RDA is 8 mg, and many people get that from food. A men's or senior multivitamin with little or no iron is the norm for a reason.

FAQ

Is 325 mg of ferrous sulfate the same as 325 mg of iron?

No. It's about 65 mg of iron, because ferrous sulfate is about 20% iron by weight. The Supplement Facts panel shows the iron amount.

Why does my Korean box say 150% for 18 mg?

Korea's daily reference value for iron is 12 mg, so 18 mg is 150% there. In the US, 18 mg is 100% DV.

Can I take iron with my calcium chew?

NIH notes that experts recommend taking them at different times, since calcium may reduce iron absorption.

Which number was on your bottle, the salt or the iron? Tell us in the comments.

Sources

  • NIH Office of Dietary Supplements. Iron: Fact Sheet for Health Professionals (updated September 4, 2025): RDAs, DV 18 mg, UL 45 mg, elemental iron by form, calcium timing, medication interactions, FDA warning label. ods.od.nih.gov (checked 2026-11-28)
  • Korea, Enforcement Rule of the Act on Labeling and Advertising of Foods, Annex 5 (daily nutrient reference values: iron 12 mg). law.go.kr (checked 2026-11-27)

t: 韓国ラクトフィット、黄色とピンクは何が違う？4種類の箱を「1日何包・何億」で読む
h:
韓国サプリノート · 2026年11月28日更新 · 商品情報はOlive Youngの商品情報提供告示（2026年11月23日確認）、価格は同日の表示価格

韓国のお土産やリピート買いでよく名前が出る「ラクトフィット」。棚の前に立つと、黄色、オレンジ、ピンク、薄い紫と箱の色が並んでいて、「どれが定番？色で何が変わるの？」と迷いますよね。

先に結論：色より先に見るのは「1日何包か」と「1日分で何億か」の2つです。黄色（ゴールド）とオレンジ（コア）は1日1包で40億、ピンク（スリム）と薄紫（ビューティー）は1日2包で20億。同じ30包入りでも、ピンクと薄紫は15日分で終わります。

ポイント

  • 黄色・オレンジ：1日1包、1日分の乳酸菌数40億、亜鉛入り。
  • ピンク・薄紫：1日2包、1日分20億。ほかの成分が足されたタイプ。
  • 30包＝30日とは限らない：1日2包なら15日分です。
  • 1日あたりは約31円〜158円：同じブランドでも5倍ほど差があります。

4種類を表で比べる

箱の色（韓国語名）1日量1日分の乳酸菌ほかの成分1日あたり
黄色・ゴールド（골드）1包40億亜鉛2.55mg₩263（約31円）
オレンジ・コア（코어）1包40億亜鉛2.55mg、菌の種類が多め₩313（約37円）
ピンク・スリム（슬림）2包20億亜鉛2.55mg、ガルシニア由来HCA 750mg₩563（約67円）
薄紫・ビューティー（뷰티）2包20億低分子コラーゲンペプチド₩1,327（約158円）

価格は2026年11月23日のOlive Young表示価格（ゴールド・コア・ビューティーは30包、スリムは30包×2個セット）から私たちが1日分を計算したもの。円は₩1,000＝約119.4円（2026年11月28日のレート）での目安です。セールで変わるので、買う前にその場の値札で計算し直してください。

箱の韓国語、ここだけ読めればOK

韓国語意味見る理由
1일 1회, 1회 1포1日1回、1回1包1日何包かがわかる
1일 2회, 1회 1포1日2回、1回1包30包＝15日分になる
프로바이오틱스 수プロバイオティクス数1日分の菌数（억＝億）
건강기능식품韓国の健康機能食品4種類ともこの表示
섭취 시 주의사항摂取時の注意事項持病・服薬中の注意が書かれている

なお、韓国の「健康機能食品」は、日本の保健機能食品（トクホ・機能性表示食品・栄養機能食品）とは別の制度です。「韓国で健康機能食品＝日本のトクホと同じ」とは考えず、箱に書かれた内容そのものを見るのが近道です。

選ぶ前に見ておきたい3つの点

  1. ピンク（スリム）の注意書き：HCA（ガルシニア由来）が入っていて、箱には肝臓・腎臓・心臓の病気、アレルギー、ぜんそくがある人や薬を飲んでいる人は専門家に相談するよう書かれています。
  2. 亜鉛の重なり：ゴールド・コア・スリムは1日2.55mgの亜鉛入り。マルチビタミンや亜鉛サプリをすでに飲んでいるなら、合計を確認しておきましょう。
  3. 開けたらすぐ：粉末は湿気を吸いやすいので、開封した包はその場で。ゴールド・コアは水なしでそのまま飲めると書かれています。

妊娠・授乳中の人、持病があって通院中の人は、共通の注意事項として「先に相談を」と書かれています。箱を見せて医師・薬剤師に聞くのがいちばん早いです。

こんな人は買わなくてOK

  • 日本ですでに乳酸菌サプリを毎日飲んでいて、特に不満がない人。
  • 「色違いを全部試したい」だけの人。まず1日1包の黄色かオレンジ1箱で、続けられるか試すほうが無駄が出ません。

よくある質問

定番はどれ？

いちばん安く、1日1包で40億なのは黄色（ゴールド）です。菌の種類を多めにしたいならオレンジ（コア）。

「40億」と「20億」はどちらが多いの？

どちらも1日分の数字です。1日分で比べるとゴールド・コアの40億のほうが多く、スリム・ビューティーは2包合わせて20億です。

いつ飲めばいい？

コアの表示では食前・食後どちらでも可となっています。毎日同じタイミングにすると飲み忘れが減ります。

まとめ

色は目印、比べるのは「1日何包」と「1日分の億」。迷ったら黄色かオレンジ、追加成分が目的ならピンク・薄紫を注意書きと一緒に確認しましょう。

お店で迷ったときのために、上の表をスクリーンショットしておくと便利です。あなたが前に買ったのは何色の箱でしたか？コメントで教えてください。

参考資料

  • Olive Young 各商品ページ「商品情報提供告示」（ラクトフィット ゴールド・コア・スリム・ビューティー、1日摂取量・機能性成分・注意事項・価格）（2026年11月23日確認）
  • 消費者庁「保健機能食品について」 caa.go.jp（2026年11月22日確認）
  • 為替レート：open.er-api.com（2026年11月28日）

内容に変更があれば、コメントで教えてください。確認して修正します。

t: 韓國保健食品寫「실온보관」是幾度？飯店、行李箱裡這樣放才對
h:
韓國保健食品筆記 · 2026年11月28日更新 · 溫度定義依韓國食品醫藥品安全處《食品的基準及規格》總則確認

在首爾買了幾盒保健食品，回到飯店翻到盒子背面，寫著「실온보관」「직사광선을 피하여」……看不懂韓文，只好先丟在窗邊或暖氣旁邊。可是12月的首爾外面很冷、房間裡又很熱，放哪裡才對？

先說結論：韓國包裝上的「실온（室溫）」有法定範圍，是1～35℃；「냉장（冷藏）」是0～10℃。大部分錠劑、膠囊只要避開陽光直射、不放在暖氣出風口旁，放在飯店抽屜或行李箱裡就可以。寫「냉장」的，才需要放進冰箱。

懶人包（4行）

  • 실온보관：韓國規定的室溫＝1～35℃，飯店房間通常在這個範圍內。
  • 냉장보관：冷藏＝0～10℃，要放冰箱。
  • 직사광선을 피하여：避免陽光直射，窗邊、暖氣旁不要放。
  • 개봉 후：開封後的說明另外看，有的會改成要冷藏。

盒子上的保存韓文，對照表

韓文中文意思溫度範圍（韓國規定）
실온보관室溫保存1～35℃
상온常溫15～25℃
냉장보관冷藏保存0～10℃
냉동冷凍-18℃以下
냉암소／차고 어두운 곳陰涼避光處0～15℃、不透光
직사광선을 피하여避免陽光直射—
서늘한 곳陰涼處規定裡沒有特別定義
개봉 후開封後看後面接的字

表中的溫度出自韓國食品醫藥品安全處公告的《식품의 기준 및 규격（食品的基準及規格）》總則。也就是說，韓國包裝寫「실온」時，不是「隨便放」，而是指1～35℃這個範圍。

首爾12月，最容易放錯的3個地方

首爾12月的平均氣溫大約0.2℃（1991～2020年平年值）。外面冷，室內暖氣又強，溫差很大，所以要注意的反而是「太熱」和「太亮」的地方：

  1. 窗邊：白天陽光直射，盒子上寫的「직사광선을 피하여」就是在說這個。
  2. 暖氣出風口、地暖上的地板：韓國很多住宿是地暖，袋子直接放地上會被持續加熱。放到桌上或抽屜裡比較穩。
  3. 浴室：洗澡後又熱又濕，粉狀、條狀的產品容易受潮結塊。

行李箱、飛機上要冰嗎？

  • 寫「실온보관」的：不用冰。跟衣服一起放在行李箱中間，避開最外層就好。
  • 寫「냉장보관」的：購買前先想好行程。逛街一整天、晚上才回飯店的話，可以最後一天再買，或問店員有沒有不需冷藏的同類產品。
  • 開封後才要冷藏的：盒子上會寫「개봉 후 냉장보관」。沒開封前照室溫放，打開後再進冰箱。

帶回台灣的數量規定（錠狀膠囊每種12瓶、合計36瓶等）請以食藥署公告為準，我們之前整理過一篇，可以搭配看。

常見問題

飯店房間開暖氣到28℃，還算「실온」嗎？

韓國規定的室溫上限是35℃，28℃在範圍內。但暖氣出風口旁邊可能更熱，放抽屜裡比較保險。

「서늘한 곳」是幾度？

韓國公告裡沒有特別定義這個詞。照字面理解成「避開熱和光的地方」就好。

冬天放在外套口袋裡出門可以嗎？

短時間沒問題，但回到室內別放在暖爐或暖氣邊，也別一直塞在貼身口袋裡。

總結

「실온」＝1～35℃，「냉장」＝0～10℃。在首爾冬天，要避開的是窗邊、地暖地板和浴室，而不是寒冷。看到「개봉 후」就多讀一行。

要帶回台灣的話，記得也看一下食藥署的數量規定那篇。你在韓國買的保健食品，盒子上寫的是哪一種？歡迎留言分享。

資料來源

  • 韓國食品醫藥品安全處《식품의 기준 및 규격》第1 總則 1.一般原則（標準溫度、常溫、室溫、微溫） 食品安全나라（2026-11-28確認）
  • 同 總則 3.用語解釋（冷藏、冷凍、冷暗所） 食品安全나라（2026-11-28確認）
  • 韓國氣象廳 首爾 1991～2020年 氣候平年值（12月平均氣溫）

內容如有變動，歡迎留言告訴我們，確認後會修正。

t: Only Have Time to Work Out on Weekends? What 63,591 People Showed About 1–2 Sessions a Week
h:
By FitQuest Note · Updated November 28, 2026 · Numbers checked against the original study on PubMed and the HHS Physical Activity Guidelines

Between work, the commute and holiday plans, weekday workouts keep falling off the calendar. Saturday and Sunday are the only time you can count on. Is cramming your exercise into the weekend worth anything, or are you just a "weekend warrior" hoping for the best?

Short answer: a large study of 63,591 adults found that people who got their weekly activity in 1 or 2 sessions had a lower risk of death over the follow-up than inactive people, similar to those who spread it across the week. It's an observational study, so it shows a link, not proof. Here's what it measured and how to build a weekend-only plan that still meets the guideline.

Quick answer

  • The study: 63,591 adults age 40+ in England and Scotland, followed with death records.
  • Weekend warriors: hit 150 minutes a week (or 75 vigorous) in just 1–2 sessions.
  • Result: about 30% lower all-cause death risk than inactive people, close to the regularly active group.
  • Limit: self-reported, observational. A link, not a guarantee.

What the researchers actually compared

The 2017 study in JAMA Internal Medicine pooled 11 rounds of the Health Survey for England and the Scottish Health Survey (1994–2012). People reported their leisure-time activity and were sorted into four groups:

GroupWhat they reportedAll-cause death risk vs inactive
InactiveNo moderate or vigorous activityReference
Insufficiently active, 1–2 sessionsUnder 150 min moderate and under 75 min vigorous34% lower (HR 0.66)
Weekend warrior150+ min moderate or 75+ vigorous, in 1–2 sessions30% lower (HR 0.70)
Regularly activeSame amount, 3+ sessions35% lower (HR 0.65)

For heart disease deaths the numbers were almost identical across the three active groups (HR 0.60, 0.60 and 0.59). For cancer deaths the weekend-warrior result (HR 0.82) wasn't statistically clear, because the range crossed 1.

The surprising row is the second one: even people who did less than the guideline, in 1–2 sessions, had a lower risk than people who did nothing. The authors concluded that 1 or 2 sessions a week "may be sufficient" to lower risk.

What this study can't tell you

  • It's observational. Active people may differ in other ways (diet, income, health). Researchers adjust for some of this, but it's still a link.
  • Activity was self-reported, once, at the start.
  • Participants were 40+ and British. Your results depend on what you do, not on a label.
  • It measured death risk, not fitness, muscle or how you feel on Monday.

A weekend-only plan that meets the guideline

The HHS Physical Activity Guidelines ask for 150–300 minutes of moderate activity a week (or 75–150 vigorous), plus muscle-strengthening on 2 or more days. They prefer it spread out, but here's how to hit the numbers in two days:

DayCardioStrength
Saturday75 min brisk walk, hike or bike15 min: squats, push-ups, rows
Sunday75 min moderate (or about 40 min of running)15 min: lunges, presses, carries
Weekday bonusWalk from a farther parking spot, 10 min—

Two 75-minute days of moderate activity add up to 150 minutes. Under the guideline, a vigorous minute counts about the same as two moderate minutes, so roughly 40 minutes of running covers a 75-minute day. Strength work is counted separately from these cardio minutes.

Make the weekend version safer

  • Ramp up. If you've been inactive, start with 30–40 minutes per day and add 10 minutes each weekend. Going from zero to two-hour sessions is how Monday knee pain starts.
  • Warm up 5–10 minutes, especially in cold weather.
  • Don't skip strength. The study looked at total activity; the guideline still wants muscles worked 2 days a week, and the weekend gives you exactly two.

New to exercise or managing a heart condition? Talk to your doctor before starting vigorous activity.

Bottom line

If weekends are all you have, use them. In this study, 1–2 sessions a week reaching 150 minutes was linked to a risk drop close to that of people who exercised more often. Something is better than nothing, and weekends count.

Who can skip this

If you already train three or more times a week, there's no reason to compress it. Spreading it out is still what the guideline prefers.

FAQ

Is being a weekend warrior as good as working out every day?

In this study, the death-risk numbers were close (HR 0.70 vs 0.65), but it's observational and didn't measure fitness or muscle.

How long should weekend workouts be?

To hit 150 minutes of moderate activity, about 75 minutes each day. Vigorous minutes count double.

Does it count if I play sports instead of the gym?

Yes. The study measured leisure-time activity, which includes sports, brisk walking and cycling.

Want a two-day plan with strength moves built in? It's in the free FitQuest app: deltoy.github.io/fitquest.

What's your weekend workout right now? Tell us in the comments.

Sources

  • O'Donovan G, Lee IM, Hamer M, Stamatakis E. Association of "Weekend Warrior" and Other Leisure Time Physical Activity Patterns With Risks for All-Cause, Cardiovascular Disease, and Cancer Mortality. JAMA Intern Med. 2017;177(3):335-342. PMID 28097313. PubMed (checked 2026-11-28)
  • U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. Physical Activity Guidelines for Americans, 2nd edition, 2018. odphp.health.gov (PDF) (checked 2026-11-26)

Spotted something out of date? Let us know and we'll check and fix it. No affiliate links.

t: 회식 날 운동, 술 마시기 전에 할까 다음 날로 미룰까? 근육 연구로 본 순서
h:
핏퀘스트 운동 노트 · 2026년 11월 28일 업데이트 · 연구 숫자는 PubMed 원문 초록으로 확인

12월 일정표에 회식이 줄줄이 잡혔어요. 저녁 7시 회식인 날, 퇴근 전에 헬스장을 잠깐 들를지, 아니면 그날은 쉬고 다음 날 운동할지 고민되죠. "운동하고 술 마시면 운동한 게 다 날아간다"는 말도 들리고요.

먼저 결론: 운동 직후 많이 마신 실험에서는, 단백질을 같이 먹어도 근육 단백질 합성이 24% 낮았어요. 그래서 근력 운동을 회식 바로 전에 몰아서 하기보다는 회식 다음 날이나 그다음 날로 근력 운동을 옮기는 쪽이 무난해요. 단, 이 연구는 8명 규모이고 마신 양도 아주 많았어요.

3줄 요약

  • 연구: 운동 직후 술을 많이 마시면 근육 단백질 합성이 단백질만 먹었을 때보다 24% 낮았음.
  • 회식 날: 근력 운동은 다음 날 이후로, 회식 날엔 걷기 정도로 가볍게.
  • 다음 날: 숙취가 심하면 쉬고, 괜찮으면 가볍게 시작해서 컨디션 보며 올리기.

연구는 실제로 뭘 했을까

2014년 PLoS One에 실린 연구(Parr 등)는 운동을 꾸준히 하는 남성 8명에게 같은 운동을 세 번 시키고, 운동 뒤에 먹고 마신 것만 바꿨어요.

조건운동 직후·4시간 뒤근육 단백질 합성 (단백질만 먹은 조건 대비)
단백질유청 단백질 25g기준
술 + 단백질알코올 + 단백질 25g24% 낮음
술 + 탄수화물알코올 + 탄수화물(말토덱스트린) 25g37% 낮음

먹고 마시는 건 운동 직후와 4시간 뒤, 두 번이었어요. 운동은 다리 근력 운동 + 자전거 30분 + 짧은 인터벌이었어요. 세 조건 모두 쉬고 있을 때보다는 합성이 늘었지만, 술이 들어간 두 조건은 단백질만 먹은 조건보다 확실히 낮았어요. 연구진은 단백질을 같이 먹어도 술이 운동 뒤 근육 반응을 떨어뜨린다고 결론 내렸어요.

그런데 마신 양이 꽤 많아요

이 실험의 알코올은 체중 1kg당 1.5g이었어요. 연구에서는 표준잔으로 약 12잔이라고 적었어요.

  • 체중 70kg이면 알코올 약 105g.
  • 도수 16.5% 소주 1병(360ml)에 든 알코올은 약 47~48g이니(제품마다 도수는 달라요, 우리 계산), 소주 2병이 넘는 양이에요.

그러니 "맥주 한 잔에도 운동이 날아간다"는 뜻은 아니에요. 다만 회식에서 2차, 3차까지 가는 날이라면 그날 근력 운동은 효율이 떨어질 수 있다고 보면 돼요.

회식 주간 운동 배치, 이렇게

요일일정운동
화평소근력 운동 40분
수회식출퇴근 걷기만, 근력은 쉬기
목회식 다음 날컨디션 괜찮으면 가볍게 걷기·스트레칭 20분
금 또는 토평소근력 운동 40분

회식 날 꼭 근력 운동을 하고 싶다면 퇴근 직전보다 출근 전 아침이 나아요. 실험은 운동 직후에 마신 경우라, 운동과 술 사이에 시간이 길수록 이 상황과는 멀어져요(그 차이를 직접 잰 연구는 아니에요).

근력 운동은 주 2일 이상이면 질병관리청·WHO 기준을 채워요. 회식 날을 피해 두 번 넣으면 충분해요.

회식 다음 날 운동할 때 체크할 것

  • 물부터: 운동 전에 물을 충분히 마시고 시작해요.
  • 강도는 낮게: 어지럽거나 속이 안 좋으면 그날은 쉬는 게 맞아요. "땀으로 술을 뺀다"는 생각으로 무리하지 마세요.
  • 무거운 무게는 다음에: 손에 힘이 덜 들어가는 날 고중량 스쿼트·데드리프트는 미뤄요.

운동을 처음 시작하거나 심장·혈압 질환이 있다면 의사와 먼저 상의하세요.

이런 분은 신경 안 써도 돼요

회식에서 한두 잔만 마시고 일찍 들어가는 분, 또는 운동 목표가 근육보다 꾸준히 걷기인 분은 일정만 지키면 충분해요.

자주 묻는 질문

운동하고 술 마시면 운동 효과가 0이 되나요?

아니에요. 연구에서도 술을 마신 조건 역시 쉬고 있을 때보다는 합성이 늘었어요. 단백질만 먹었을 때보다 낮았을 뿐이에요.

술 마신 다음 날 운동하면 땀으로 술이 빠지나요?

땀을 낸다고 술이 빨리 깬다고 기대하지 않는 게 좋아요. 이 연구도 다음 날 운동은 다루지 않았어요. 숙취가 있으면 물을 마시고 쉬거나 가볍게 걷는 정도가 안전해요.

회식 전에 단백질을 먹어 두면 괜찮을까요?

연구에서 단백질을 같이 먹어도 24% 낮았어요. 단백질만으로 상쇄되지는 않았어요.

정리

회식 날은 걷기, 근력 운동은 회식을 피해 주 2번. 많이 마신 다음 날은 가볍게, 몸이 괜찮을 때 다시 무게를 올려요.

회식 일정을 피해 이번 주 근력 운동 2번을 배치해 두고 싶다면 무료 핏퀘스트 앱에서 바로 짤 수 있어요: deltoy.github.io/fitquest
